summary: Brackets a Cayley-Dickson 16-vector five ways, classifies each group as C/H/O/FRAGMENT by closure, and walks the brackets in a sigma_RB-phased firing order -- the ascent dual of Generational Lineage.

provenance.origin: The ascent side of the Generational Lineage engine (e10, 2026-08-18): lineage walks descent (what built this), the Emerger walks generation (what this builds). The five standard bracketings {1:15} {2:14} {8:8} {4:4:4:4} {4:8:4} are the Cayley-Dickson order-of-operations losses read forward; e0 is the anchor, never bracketed.

constants.role: tilt (Re) + axis (Im) -- two 8-vectors; sets the firing phase
Lambert-W fixed point W(1); the 3 rotor faces of the 12-step precession
the Zero Definer, Omega_ZS/ln(10); the 4 catastrophe/fold faces

environment.arithmetic: fractions.Fraction exact; float only at output boundary
